market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool have consistently been among the EPL's strongest teams, finishing top 4 in four of the last five seasons. With an experienced squad, a top manager, and strong financial backing, a repeat top-4 finish is highly likely. Market price of 52.5% heavily undervalues this probability, offering significant edge on Yes.
